author: reek
body: Domain types for the Codex Aquarium. These records define the scene model -- species, body profiles, fins, decorations, tank geometry. The emitter walks these to produce JavaScript.

author: reek
body: Schema for the creature asset pipeline. A CreatureRecord is the complete specification for generating, texturing, rigging, and rendering one aquatic creature. It carries enough information to drive the full pipeline: reference image generation (prompt + body plan), mesh generation (TripoSR params), per-part texture baking (diffuse + normal + specular per sub-unit), rig definition (bone chain + fin attachment), and runtime behavior (boids params + animation curves). Keyed by common name for full-text lookup; indexed by taxonomy for browsing.

author: reek
body: Table definitions for the Data quire. The creature table is the primary store; full-text index on name + description + family for the search box. Texture and sub-unit tables are normalized out so the pipeline can query "all textures not yet baked" or "all sub-units needing rigs" without scanning creature records.
